test_title: PYST 19: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Manjit has borrowed an amount of ₹2,20,000 from a bank to start a business. How much simple interest (in ₹) will he pay at a rate of 4% per annum after 2 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2,20,000

Rate of Interest (R) = 4% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculations:**

SI = (2,20,000 × 4 × 2) / 100

⇒ SI = (17,60,000) / 100

⇒ SI = 17,600

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
